edges.notes: AWS Config ingests resource configuration findings into Security Hub.
GuardDuty ingests threat detection findings into Security Hub.
IAM Access Analyzer ingests policy evaluation findings into Security Hub.
Prowler running on Fargate sends ISO 27001 compliance findings to Security Hub.
Platform Engineer reviews finding exposure in Security Hub and triggers custom remediation.
Security Hub publishes finding event to EventBridge.
EventBridge rule triggers Lambda remediation function based on finding type.
SecOps Engineer creates and manages incidents in ServiceNow.
Security Hub exports cloud security findings to ServiceNow.
ServiceNow pushes updates and incident resolution status back into Security Hub.
